title: 6.8 Cross the bridge
unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
goal: Follow and give directions over a bridge and along a river (Cross the bridge and walk along the river.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.8 Following Directions: A1 follows go straight, turn, cross the street and go past; A1+ 6.8 takes the route over water. The new items are bridge and river, A1's cross with the bridge (Cross the bridge.) and along (Walk along the river.), joined with and to 6.7's Turn left at the bakery. Ana crosses a wooden footbridge, large in the photo; Luis walks on a path right beside a river with no bridge in sight.
prerequisite: A1 6.8 cross the street, go straight, turn; A1+ 6.7 turn at a place; A1+ 1 walk.
speaking_outcome: Stress BRIDGE and RIV-er; link walk along (wah-ka-LONG). Do not require native-like speed.
